args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Power adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops/beach sandals
- Hat with wide brim
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes (for Diamond Head)
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Small backpack/daypack
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit

PERSONAL CARE:
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Prescription medications
- Motion sickness medication
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hairbrush/comb
- Deodorant

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Pearl Harbor: Respectful attire (covered shoulders, no shorts)
- Luau: Hawaiian shirt/dress (optional but fun)
- Spa day: Nothing needed (provided by spa)
- Kayaking: Quick-dry clothing, waterproof bag for valuables

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for day trips
- Reusable shopping bag (for Ala Moana Center)
- Small umbrella or rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
